oracle.driver: read_recipe + materialize_bundled_skill / materialize_command / materialize_doc with go_apply_copy replaced by a recorder and write_lock a no-op
oracle.note: Frozen snapshot of the legacy materialize copy call sites over the catalog and case below, captured once. The host-dependent segments are tokens: <BASE> is the temporary base directory the fixture was built under and <CACHE> is the per-project cache key directory (a sha256 of the project's absolute path). No mode, clock or host path is frozen. Regenerating it needs a human decision.
